key_findings: Peptide H-20 binds PD-1, induces SHP-1 phosphorylation and suppresses DRG neuron excitability and capsaicin/TRPV1 calcium responses in a PD-1-dependent manner.
Spinal H-20 was analgesic in multiple inflammatory, visceral and neuropathic models with minimal tolerance, abuse liability, itch and motor impairment.
